questions.q: Whom does Yahweh say he is raising up, in Habakkuk 1?
questions.evidence: For, behold, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, that march through the width of the earth, to possess dwelling places that are not theirs

questions.q: The righteous will live by what, in Habakkuk 2?
questions.evidence: It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith

questions.q: Though the fig tree fails, what will Habakkuk still do?
questions.evidence: the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls: yet I will rejoice in Yahweh
